docs.title: ...craft the Just Dire Things paxel?
docs.text:
To craft the celestigem or eclipse alloy paxels from the mod Just Dire Things you need to place all three component tools—pickaxe, axe, and shovel—into the smithing table.

Success

EMI now correctly displays this recipe, in recent versions of Craftoria.

docs.title: ...obtain the Hazen items?
docs.text:
Most of the items are craftable, but there's a list of ones that are not:

  • Arbitrium Armor (Creative only)
  • Excalibur Fragment (Obtained by Killing the Dead King)
  • Fireblossom (Found in Crimson Forests in the Nether)
  • Rod Of Discord & Starfury (Rare drop from Endermen)
  • Overgrown/Charred bones (Dropped from Bogged and Wither Skeletons respectively)

docs.title: ...find the items on the Replicator Mk1 and Mk2 blacklists?
docs.text:

  • #replicator_1_blacklist (for Mk1)
  • #replicator_blacklist (for Mk2)

docs.title: ...calculate energy conversion from one kind to another?
docs.text:
EU FE AE J E LF 0.1 1 2 2.5 1 1 1

Conversion ratios of various Energies

In Craftoria the Flux Transformer will convert 1 EU to 50 FE, only. Connecting EU directly to anything that runs on FE will yield a 1 EU : 10 FE result.

Info

No energy kind can be converted into EU. However Modern Industrialization has a config option for MI to allow this, if you wish it for you own worlds.

docs.title: Game Settings
docs.text:
If your game is struggling, try:

  • Turning down Render Distance
  • Look into JVM args (see next section)
  • Giving it some more RAM——but not so much GC pauses noticeably lengthen.

docs.text:
Around 6–8GB should work well for any AOE modpacks.

Prism Launcher is popular among avid modded Minecraft players.

You can get it from: prismlauncher.org, and it has it's own wiki.

docs.title: Key Settings To Know
docs.text:
Prism's settings can be found in two windows:

  1. The Settings window reached from the [Settings] button of Prism's main window.
  2. Each instances' own Console window, opened by the [Edit] button in the right margin of the main window.

Memory allocation, java path, and JVM arguments can all found in the Settings window's Java section, or an instance's Console window's Settings section java tab.

Main WindowGeneral Settings Java tabPer-Instance Java tab

docs.title: High Pressure Loop: Advanced Boiler<sup>*</sup>  Heat Exchanger
docs.text:
* or Fission Reactor... which is a pretty advanced way to boil water, don't you think?

Fuel and Water go in, Steam comes out, and HP water re-circulates

A pressurizer is needed to initially prime the loop with HP water. It won't take much, as 125mB of HP water takes up 16 times as much volume when turned to HP steam (2,000mB).

Tip

If you are running (and thus boiling) HP water or HP heavy-water through a fission reactor, a small portion will be converted to Deuterium or Tritium, and this amount will need to be continually replaced.

docs.title: Installing a local server
docs.text:
1. Download and unzip the server zip file from CurseForge.
  2. Run the startserver.bat script. (or .sh, on linux or macOS)
  3. Respond with TRUE to the EULA question.

Now you should have a running local server.

Note

Be sure you have the right Java version for the modpack you want to play

docs.title: Installing a hosted server
docs.text:
The choices here depend on the hosting service you have chosen.

Generally, they may offer pre-packaged installs for modpacks—including AOE's—or you may upload a working server install.

For the later, upload the whole server created with the local server install process described above. Consult your hosting service for how exactly to setup starting your uploaded server; the details depend on their service.
